SELECT count(DISTINCT t.cs_order_number) AS "order count", sum(t.cs_ext_ship_cost) AS "total shipping cost", sum(t.cs_net_profit) AS "total net profit"
FROM (
  SELECT cs1.cs_order_number, cs1.cs_ext_ship_cost, cs1.cs_net_profit
  FROM catalog_sales cs1
  JOIN date_dim d ON cs1.cs_ship_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON cs1.cs_ship_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN call_center cc ON cs1.cs_call_center_sk = cc.cc_call_center_sk
  WHERE d.d_date BETWEEN '2002-02-01' AND cast('2002-04-02' AS date)
    AND ca.ca_state = 'GA'
    AND cc.cc_county = 'Williamson County'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_sales cs2 WHERE cs1.cs_order_number = cs2.cs_order_number AND cs1.cs_warehouse_sk <> cs2.cs_warehouse_sk)
) t
LEFT JOIN catalog_returns cr1 ON t.cs_order_number = cr1.cr_order_number
WHERE cr1.cr_order_number IS NULL
ORDER BY count(DISTINCT t.cs_order_number)
LIMIT 100

WITH base_sales AS (
  SELECT ss_ext_sales_price, p_channel_dmail, p_channel_email, p_channel_tv
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
  JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
  JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  LEFT JOIN promotion p ON ss.ss_promo_sk = p.p_promo_sk
  WHERE ca.ca_gmt_offset = -5
    AND i.i_category = 'Jewelry'
    AND s.s_gmt_offset = -5
    AND d.d_year = 1998
    AND d.d_moy = 11
)
SELECT promotions, total, cast(promotions AS decimal(15,4))/cast(total AS decimal(15,4))*100
FROM (
  SELECT sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS promotions,
         sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS total
  FROM base_sales
) t
ORDER BY promotions, total
LIMIT 100

WITH item_revenue AS (
  SELECT ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk, sum(ss_sales_price) AS revenue
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1176 AND 1176 + 11
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk, ss_item_sk
),
store_avg AS (
  SELECT ss_store_sk, avg(revenue) AS ave
  FROM item_revenue
  GROUP BY ss_store_sk
)
SELECT s_store_name, i_item_desc, ir.revenue, i_current_price, i_wholesale_cost, i_brand
FROM item_revenue ir
JOIN store_avg sa ON ir.ss_store_sk = sa.ss_store_sk
JOIN store s ON s.s_store_sk = ir.ss_store_sk
JOIN item i ON i.i_item_sk = ir.ss_item_sk
WHERE ir.revenue <= 0.1 * sa.ave
ORDER BY s_store_name NULLS FIRST, i_item_desc NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

WITH dj AS (
  SELECT ss_ticket_number,
         ss_customer_sk,
         count(*) AS cnt
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN store s ON ss.ss_store_sk = s.s_store_sk
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  WHERE d.d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
    AND (hd.hd_buy_potential = 'Unknown' OR hd.hd_buy_potential = '>10000')
    AND hd.hd_vehicle_count > 0
    AND (hd.hd_dep_count * 1.000 / hd.hd_vehicle_count) > 1
    AND d.d_year IN (1999, 2000, 2001)
    AND s.s_county IN ('Orange County', 'Bronx County', 'Franklin Parish', 'Williamson County')
  GROUP BY ss_ticket_number, ss_customer_sk
)
SELECT c.c_last_name,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       dj.ss_ticket_number,
       dj.cnt
FROM dj
JOIN customer c ON dj.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, c.c_last_name ASC

  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk

  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'web' AS channel, 'ws_ship_customer_sk' AS col_name, d_year, d_qoy, i_category, ws_ext_sales_price AS ext_sales_price

  WHERE cs_ship_addr_sk IS NULL
)

This rewrite pushes the CASE logic into the HAVING clause of the inner query if possible, but HAVING runs before window functions. So we keep the structure but simplify the outer WHERE.
sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy, sum(ss_sales_price) sum_sales, avg(sum(ss_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name) avg_monthly_sales FROM item JOIN store_sales ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk WHERE d_year = 1999 AND ((i_category IN ('Books','Electronics','Sports') AND i_class IN ('computers','stereo','football')) OR (i_category IN ('Men','Jewelry','Women') AND i_class IN ('shirts','birdal','dresses'))) GROUP BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy) tmp1 WHERE CASE WHEN (avg_monthly_sales <> 0) THEN (abs(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales) ELSE NULL END > 0.1 ORDER BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales, s_store_name, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 LIMIT 100

sql: WITH sums AS (SELECT i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy, sum(ss_sales_price) sum_sales FROM item JOIN store_sales ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk WHERE d_year = 1999 AND ((i_category IN ('Books','Electronics','Sports') AND i_class IN ('computers','stereo','football')) OR (i_category IN ('Men','Jewelry','Women') AND i_class IN ('shirts','birdal','dresses'))) GROUP BY i_category, i_class, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, d_moy), avgs AS (SELECT i_category, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name, avg(sum_sales) avg_monthly_sales FROM sums GROUP BY i_category, i_brand, s_store_name, s_company_name) SELECT s.i_category, s.i_class, s.i_brand, s.s_store_name, s.s_company_name, s.d_moy, s.sum_sales, a.avg_monthly_sales FROM sums s JOIN avgs a ON s.i_category = a.i_category AND s.i_brand = a.i_brand AND s.s_store_name = a.s_store_name AND s.s_company_name = a.s_company_name WHERE CASE WHEN (a.avg_monthly_sales <> 0) THEN (abs(s.sum_sales - a.avg_monthly_sales) / a.avg_monthly_sales) ELSE NULL END > 0.1 ORDER BY s.sum_sales - a.avg_monthly_sales, s.s_store_name, 1, 2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8 LIMIT 100

strategy: Common Table Expression (CTE) to avoid repeated joins and scans
sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT t.t_hour
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN household_demographics hd ON ws.ws_ship_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
  JOIN time_dim t ON ws.ws_sold_time_sk = t.t_time_sk
  JOIN web_page wp ON ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
  WHERE hd.hd_dep_count = 6
    AND wp.wp_char_count BETWEEN 5000 AND 5200
    AND (t.t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 9 OR t.t_hour BETWEEN 19 AND 20)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN pmc = 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST(amc AS DECIMAL(15,4)) / CAST(pmc AS DECIMAL(15,4)) END AS am_pm_ratio
FROM (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN t_hour BETWEEN 8 AND 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS amc,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t_hour BETWEEN 19 AND 20 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pmc
  FROM base
) stats
ORDER BY am_pm_ratio
LIMIT 100

WITH year_total AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           d_year AS dyear,
           sum(((ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_wholesale_cost - ss_ext_discount_amt) + ss_ext_sales_price) / 2) AS year_total,
           's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           d_year AS dyear,
           sum(((cs_ext_list_price - cs_ext_wholesale_cost - cs_ext_discount_amt) + cs_ext_sales_price) / 2) AS year_total,
           'c' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    JOIN catalog_sales ON c_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           d_year AS dyear,
           sum(((ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_wholesale_cost - ws_ext_discount_amt) + ws_ext_sales_price) / 2) AS year_total,
           'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, d_year
)
SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id,
       t_s_secyear.customer_first_name,
       t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
       t_s_secyear.customer_preferred_cust_flag
FROM year_total t_s_firstyear
JOIN year_total t_s_secyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_s_secyear.customer_id
JOIN year_total t_c_firstyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_c_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN year_total t_c_secyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_c_secyear.customer_id
JOIN year_total t_w_firstyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN year_total t_w_secyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id
WHERE t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's'
  AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's'
  AND t_c_firstyear.sale_type = 'c'
  AND t_c_secyear.sale_type = 'c'
  AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w'
  AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w'
  AND t_s_firstyear.dyear = 2001
  AND t_s_secyear.dyear = 2002
  AND t_c_firstyear.dyear = 2001
  AND t_c_secyear.dyear = 2002
  AND t_w_firstyear.dyear = 2001
  AND t_w_secyear.dyear = 2002
  AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0
  AND t_c_firstyear.year_total > 0
  AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
  AND CASE WHEN t_c_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN t_c_secyear.year_total / t_c_firstyear.year_total ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN t_s_secyear.year_total / t_s_firstyear.year_total ELSE NULL END
  AND CASE WHEN t_c_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN t_c_secyear.year_total / t_c_firstyear.year_total ELSE NULL END > CASE WHEN t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 THEN t_w_secyear.year_total / t_w_firstyear.year_total ELSE NULL END
ORDER BY t_s_secyear.customer_id NULLS FIRST,
         t_s_secyear.customer_first_name NULLS FIRST,
         t_s_secyear.customer_last_name NULLS FIRST,
         t_s_secyear.customer_preferred_cust_flag NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

strategy: Conditional Aggregation (Pivot): Replace the six-way self-join on the CTE with a single aggregation using conditional SUMs to pivot sale types and years into columns. This eliminates the expensive self-joins and reduces the number of passes over the data.

WITH base_sales AS (
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           d_year AS dyear,
           's' AS sale_type,
           ((ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_wholesale_cost - ss_ext_discount_amt) + ss_ext_sales_price) / 2 AS sales_val
    FROM customer
    JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           d_year AS dyear,
           'c' AS sale_type,
           ((cs_ext_list_price - cs_ext_wholesale_cost - cs_ext_discount_amt) + cs_ext_sales_price) / 2 AS sales_val
    FROM customer
    JOIN catalog_sales ON c_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id,
           c_first_name AS customer_first_name,
           c_last_name AS customer_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag AS customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           d_year AS dyear,
           'w' AS sale_type,
           ((ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_wholesale_cost - ws_ext_discount_amt) + ws_ext_sales_price) / 2 AS sales_val
    FROM customer
    JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT customer_id,
           customer_first_name,
           customer_last_name,
           customer_preferred_cust_flag,
           SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 2001 THEN sales_val ELSE 0 END) AS s_2001,
           SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 's' AND dyear = 2002 THEN sales_val ELSE 0 END) AS s_2002,
           SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 'c' AND dyear = 2001 THEN sales_val ELSE 0 END) AS c_2001,
           SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 'c' AND dyear = 2002 THEN sales_val ELSE 0 END) AS c_2002,
           SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 2001 THEN sales_val ELSE 0 END) AS w_2001,
           SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 'w' AND dyear = 2002 THEN sales_val ELSE 0 END) AS w_2002
    FROM base_sales
    GROUP BY customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, customer_preferred_cust_flag
)
SELECT customer_id,
       customer_first_name,
       customer_last_name,
       customer_preferred_cust_flag
FROM pivoted
WHERE s_2001 > 0
  AND c_2001 > 0
  AND w_2001 > 0
  AND (CASE WHEN c_2001 > 0 THEN c_2002 / c_2001 ELSE NULL END) > (CASE WHEN s_2001 > 0 THEN s_2002 / s_2001 ELSE NULL END)
  AND (CASE WHEN c_2001 > 0 THEN c_2002 / c_2001 ELSE NULL END) > (CASE WHEN w_2001 > 0 THEN w_2002 / w_2001 ELSE NULL END)
ORDER BY customer_id NULLS FIRST,
         customer_first_name NULLS FIRST,
         customer_last_name NULLS FIRST,
         customer_preferred_cust_flag NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

WITH year_total AS (
  SELECT c_customer_id, d_year, sale_type,
         SUM(((ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_wholesale_cost-ss_ext_discount_amt)+ss_ext_sales_price)/2) as year_total
  FROM customer, store_sales, date_dim
  WHERE c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, d_year, 's'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c_customer_id, d_year, sale_type,
         SUM(((cs_ext_list_price-cs_ext_wholesale_cost-cs_ext_discount_amt)+cs_ext_sales_price)/2)
  FROM customer, catalog_sales, date_dim
  WHERE c_customer_sk = cs_bill_customer_sk AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, d_year, 'c'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c_customer_id, d_year, sale_type,
         SUM(((ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_wholesale_cost-ws_ext_discount_amt)+ws_ext_sales_price)/2)
  FROM customer, web_sales, date_dim
  WHERE c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, d_year, 'w'
),

         MAX(CASE WHEN sale_type = 'w' THEN year_total END) as w_total

WITH ssr AS
  (SELECT s_store_id,
          sum(sales_price) AS sales,
          sum(profit) AS profit,
          sum(return_amt) AS returns_,
          sum(net_loss) AS profit_loss
   FROM
     (SELECT ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
             ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
             ss_net_profit AS profit,
             cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS return_amt,
             cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS net_loss
      FROM store_sales
      WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-06' AS date))
      UNION ALL SELECT sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
                       cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS sales_price,
                       cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS profit,
                       sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
                       sr_net_loss AS net_loss
      FROM store_returns
      WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-06' AS date)) ) salesreturns,
        store
   WHERE store_sk = s_store_sk
   GROUP BY s_store_id) ,
     csr AS
  (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id,
          sum(sales_price) AS sales,
          sum(profit) AS profit,
          sum(return_amt) AS returns_,
          sum(net_loss) AS profit_loss
   FROM
     (SELECT cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
             cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
             cs_net_profit AS profit,
             cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS return_amt,
             cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS net_loss
      FROM catalog_sales
      WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-06' AS date))
      UNION ALL SELECT cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
                       cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS sales_price,
                       cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS profit,
                       cr_return_amount AS return_amt,
                       cr_net_loss AS net_loss
      FROM catalog_returns
      WHERE cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-06' AS date)) ) salesreturns,
        catalog_page
   WHERE page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
   GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id) ,
     wsr AS
  (SELECT web_site_id,
          sum(sales_price) AS sales,
          sum(profit) AS profit,
          sum(return_amt) AS returns_,
          sum(net_loss) AS profit_loss
   FROM
     (SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
             ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
             ws_net_profit AS profit,
             cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS return_amt,
             cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS net_loss
      FROM web_sales
      WHERE ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-06' AS date))
      UNION ALL SELECT ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
                       cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS sales_price,
                       cast(0 AS decimal(7,2)) AS profit,
                       wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
                       wr_net_loss AS net_loss
      FROM web_returns
      LEFT OUTER JOIN web_sales ON (wr_item_sk = ws_item_sk
                                    AND wr_order_number = ws_order_number)
      WHERE wr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-06' AS date)) ) salesreturns,
        web_site
   WHERE wsr_web_site_sk = web_site_sk
   GROUP BY web_site_id)
SELECT channel ,
       id ,
       sum(sales) AS sales ,
       sum(returns_) AS returns_ ,
       sum(profit) AS profit
FROM
  (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel ,
          concat('store', s_store_id) AS id ,
          sales ,
          returns_ ,
          (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
   FROM ssr
   UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel ,
                    concat('catalog_page', cp_catalog_page_id) AS id ,
                    sales ,
                    returns_ ,
                    (profit - profit_loss) AS profit

WITH year_total AS

          c_last_name customer_last_name,
          c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
          c_birth_country customer_birth_country,
          c_login customer_login,
          c_email_address customer_email_address,
          d_year dyear,
          sum(ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt) year_total,
          's' sale_type
   FROM customer,
        store_sales,
        date_dim
   WHERE c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
     AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
     AND d_year IN (2001, 2002)
   GROUP BY c_customer_id,
            c_first_name,
            c_last_name,
            c_preferred_cust_flag,
            c_birth_country,
            c_login,
            c_email_address,
            d_year
   UNION ALL SELECT c_customer_id customer_id,
                    c_first_name customer_first_name,

                    c_birth_country customer_birth_country,

                    c_email_address customer_email_address,
                    d_year dyear,
                    sum(ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt) year_total,
                    'w' sale_type
   FROM customer,
        web_sales,
        date_dim
   WHERE c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
     AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
     AND d_year IN (2001, 2002)
   GROUP BY c_customer_id,

SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id,

       t_s_secyear.customer_last_name,
       t_s_secyear.customer_preferred_cust_flag
FROM year_total t_s_firstyear,
     year_total t_s_secyear,

  AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0

                ELSE 0.0
            END

         t_s_secyear.customer_first_name NULLS FIRST,

strategy: Conditional Aggregation (Pivot): Calculate year totals for 2001 and 2002 in a single pass per channel using CASE WHEN inside SUM, reducing the number of rows generated by the CTE and subsequent joins.

WITH store_pivot AS
  (SELECT c_customer_id customer_id,
          c_first_name customer_first_name,
          c_last_name customer_last_name,
          c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
          SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2001 THEN ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) s_2001,
          SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2002 THEN ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) s_2002
   FROM customer,
        store_sales,
        date_dim
   WHERE c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
     AND ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
     AND d_year IN (2001, 2002)
   GROUP BY c_customer_id,
            c_first_name,
            c_last_name,
            c_preferred_cust_flag),
web_pivot AS
  (SELECT c_customer_id customer_id,
          c_first_name customer_first_name,
          c_last_name customer_last_name,
          c_preferred_cust_flag customer_preferred_cust_flag,
          SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2001 THEN ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) w_2001,
          SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2002 THEN ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) w_2002
   FROM customer,
        web_sales,
        date_dim
   WHERE c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
     AND ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
     AND d_year IN (2001, 2002)
   GROUP BY c_customer_id,
            c_first_name,
            c_last_name,
            c_preferred_cust_flag)
SELECT s.customer_id,
       s.customer_first_name,
       s.customer_last_name,
       s.customer_preferred_cust_flag
FROM store_pivot s
JOIN web_pivot w ON s.customer_id = w.customer_id
WHERE s.s_2001 > 0
  AND w.w_2001 > 0
  AND (w.w_2002 * 1.0000) / w.w_2001 > (s.s_2002 * 1.0000) / s.s_2001
ORDER BY s.customer_id NULLS FIRST,
         s.customer_first_name NULLS FIRST,
         s.customer_last_name NULLS FIRST,
         s.customer_preferred_cust_flag NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

strategy: Conditional Aggregation (Pivot): Scan each sales fact table once, aggregating sales by year into separate columns. This avoids multiple joins on the customer key and reduces the number of table scans from 4 to 2.
sql: WITH ss_pivot AS (SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2001 THEN ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) as s_2001, SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2002 THEN ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) as s_2002 FROM customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4), ws_pivot AS (SELECT c_customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2001 THEN ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) as w_2001, SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2002 THEN ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt ELSE 0 END) as w_2002 FROM customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002) GROUP BY 1) SELECT ss.customer_id, ss.customer_first_name, ss.customer_last_name, ss.customer_preferred_cust_flag FROM ss_pivot ss JOIN ws_pivot ws ON ss.c_customer_id = ws.c_customer_id WHERE ss.s_2001 > 0 AND ws.w_2001 > 0 AND (ws.w_2002 * 1.0000) / ws.w_2001 > (ss.s_2002 * 1.0000) / ss.s_2001 ORDER BY ss.customer_id NULLS FIRST, ss.customer_first_name NULLS FIRST, ss.customer_last_name NULLS FIRST, ss.customer_preferred_cust_flag NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

strategy: CTE Materialization with Predicate Pushdown: Use CTEs but explicitly filter years inside the CTE definitions before aggregation. This helps PostgreSQL materialize smaller intermediate results compared to the original which filtered in the outer join.
sql: WITH ss_data AS (SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, d_year, sum(ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt) as year_total FROM customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5), ws_data AS (SELECT c_customer_id, d_year, sum(ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt) as year_total FROM customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002) GROUP BY 1, 2) SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name, t_s_secyear.customer_preferred_cust_flag FROM ss_data t_s_secyear JOIN ss_data t_s_firstyear ON t_s_secyear.customer_id = t_s_firstyear.customer_id AND t_s_secyear.d_year = 2002 AND t_s_firstyear.d_year = 2001 JOIN ws_data t_w_firstyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id AND t_w_firstyear.d_year = 2001 JOIN ws_data t_w_secyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id AND t_w_secyear.d_year = 2002 WHERE t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0 AND (t_w_secyear.year_total*1.0000) / t_w_firstyear.year_total > (t_s_secyear.year_total*1.0000) / t_s_firstyear.year_total ORDER BY t_s_secyear.customer_id NULLS FIRST, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name NULLS FIRST, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name NULLS FIRST, t_s_secyear.customer_preferred_cust_flag NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

strategy: Simplified Logic & Join Reordering: Remove redundant CASE statements (since denominators are checked > 0) and reorder joins to start with the most selective filtered subsets (Year 2001 Store Sales) to reduce intermediate row counts early.
sql: SELECT s2.customer_id, s2.customer_first_name, s2.customer_last_name, s2.customer_preferred_cust_flag FROM (SELECT c_customer_id, sum(ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt) as yt FROM customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year = 2001 GROUP BY c_customer_id HAVING sum(ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt) > 0) s1 JOIN (SELECT c_customer_id, sum(ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt) as yt FROM customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year = 2002 GROUP BY c_customer_id) s2 ON s1.c_customer_id = s2.c_customer_id JOIN (SELECT c_customer_id, sum(ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt) as yt FROM customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year = 2001 GROUP BY c_customer_id HAVING sum(ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt) > 0) w1 ON s1.c_customer_id = w1.c_customer_id JOIN (SELECT c_customer_id, sum(ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt) as yt FROM customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year = 2002 GROUP BY c_customer_id) w2 ON s1.c_customer_id = w2.c_customer_id JOIN customer c ON s1.c_customer_id = c.c_customer_id WHERE (w2.yt * 1.0000) / w1.yt > (s2.yt * 1.0000) / s1.yt ORDER BY c.c_customer_id NULLS FIRST, c.c_first_name NULLS FIRST, c.c_last_name NULLS FIRST, c.c_preferred_cust_flag NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

strategy: Union-All with Window Functions: Combine store and web sales into a single stream with a 'source' tag, then use window functions or self-joins on the combined set. This strategy leverages a single pass over customer demographics info if structured correctly, though here it focuses on reducing join complexity by normalizing the sales source.
sql: WITH combined_sales AS (SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, d_year, 's' as src, sum(ss_ext_list_price-ss_ext_discount_amt) as yt FROM customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 UNION ALL SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, c_preferred_cust_flag, d_year, 'w' as src, sum(ws_ext_list_price-ws_ext_discount_amt) as yt FROM customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6) SELECT s2.customer_id, s2.customer_first_name, s2.customer_last_name, s2.customer_preferred_cust_flag FROM combined_sales s1 JOIN combined_sales s2 ON s1.customer_id = s2.customer_id JOIN combined_sales w1 ON s1.customer_id = w1.customer_id JOIN combined_sales w2 ON s1.customer_id = w2.customer_id WHERE s1.src = 's' AND s1.d_year = 2001 AND s2.src = 's' AND s2.d_year = 2002 AND w1.src = 'w' AND w1.d_year = 2001 AND w2.src = 'w' AND w2.d_year = 2002 AND s1.yt > 0 AND w1.yt > 0 AND (w2.yt * 1.0000) / w1.yt > (s2.yt * 1.0000) / s1.yt ORDER BY s2.customer_id NULLS FIRST, s2.customer_first_name NULLS FIRST, s2.customer_last_name NULLS FIRST, s2.customer_preferred_cust_flag NULLS FIRST LIMIT 100

strategy: Pre-aggregate average_sales and cross_items to avoid repeated subquery execution in HAVING and IN clauses. Use explicit JOINs for cross_items intersection logic.
sql:
WITH cross_items AS (
  SELECT i_item_sk
  FROM item
  WHERE (i_brand_id, i_class_id, i_category_id) IN (
    SELECT iss.i_brand_id, iss.i_class_id, iss.i_category_id
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN item iss ON ss_item_sk = iss.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2001
    INTERSECT
    SELECT ics.i_brand_id, ics.i_class_id, ics.i_category_id
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN item ics ON cs_item_sk = ics.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON cs_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2001
    INTERSECT
    SELECT iws.i_brand_id, iws.i_class_id, iws.i_category_id
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN item iws ON ws_item_sk = iws.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON ws_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE d3.d_year BETWEEN 1999 AND 2001
  )
),
avg_sales_val AS (

WITH ss_agg AS (
    SELECT ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_store_sk,
           SUM(ss_quantity) as sum_q, COUNT(ss_quantity) as cnt_q, SUM(ss_quantity * ss_quantity) as sum_q2
    FROM store_sales s
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON s.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    WHERE d1.d_quarter_name = '2001Q1'
    GROUP BY ss_item_sk, ss_customer_sk, ss_store_sk
),
sr_agg AS (
    SELECT sr_item_sk, sr_customer_sk,
           SUM(sr_return_quantity) as sum_q, COUNT(sr_return_quantity) as cnt_q, SUM(sr_return_quantity * sr_return_quantity) as sum_q2
    FROM store_returns r
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON r.sr_returned_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    WHERE d2.d_quarter_name IN ('2001Q1', '2001Q2', '2001Q3')
    GROUP BY sr_item_sk, sr_customer_sk
),
cs_agg AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk,
           SUM(cs_quantity) as sum_q, COUNT(cs_quantity) as cnt_q, SUM(cs_quantity * cs_quantity) as sum_q2
    FROM catalog_sales c
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON c.cs_sold_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    WHERE d3.d_quarter_name IN ('2001Q1', '2001Q2', '2001Q3')
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk, cs_bill_customer_sk
)
SELECT i.i_item_id,
       i.i_item_desc,
       s.s_state,
       SUM(ss_agg.cnt_q) AS store_sales_quantitycount,
       SUM(ss_agg.sum_q) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_agg.cnt_q), 0) AS store_sales_quantityave,
       SQRT((SUM(ss_agg.sum_q2) - POWER(SUM(ss_agg.sum_q), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_agg.cnt_q), 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_agg.cnt_q) - 1, 0)) AS store_sales_quantitystdev,
       SQRT((SUM(ss_agg.sum_q2) - POWER(SUM(ss_agg.sum_q), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_agg.cnt_q), 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_agg.cnt_q) - 1, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_agg.sum_q) / NULLIF(SUM(ss_agg.cnt_q), 0), 0) AS store_sales_quantitycov,
       SUM(sr_agg.cnt_q) AS store_returns_quantitycount,
       SUM(sr_agg.sum_q) / NULLIF(SUM(sr_agg.cnt_q), 0) AS store_returns_quantityave,
       SQRT((SUM(sr_agg.sum_q2) - POWER(SUM(sr_agg.sum_q), 2) / NULLIF(SUM(sr_agg.cnt_q), 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(sr_agg.cnt_q) - 1, 0)) AS store_returns_quantitystdev,

       SUM(cs_agg.cnt_q) AS catalog_sales_quantitycount,
       SUM(cs_agg.sum_q) / NULLIF(SUM(cs_agg.cnt_q), 0) AS catalog_sales_quantityave,

sql:
WITH frequent_ss_items AS (
  SELECT SUBSTRING(i_item_desc, 1, 30) AS itemdesc,
         i_item_sk AS item_sk,
         d_date AS solddate,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
  WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002, 2003)
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 4
),
customer_sales AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk,
         SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS total_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002, 2003)
  GROUP BY c_customer_sk
),
global_max AS (
  SELECT MAX(total_sales) AS tpcds_cmax
  FROM customer_sales
),
best_ss_customer AS (
  SELECT c_customer_sk
  FROM customer_sales
  CROSS JOIN global_max
  WHERE total_sales > 0.5 * tpcds_cmax
)
SELECT c_last_name,
       c_first_name,
       sales
FROM (
  SELECT c_last_name,
         c_first_name,
         SUM(cs_quantity * cs_list_price) AS sales
  FROM catalog_sales
  JOIN customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN best_ss_customer ON cs_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk
  JOIN frequent_ss_items ON cs_item_sk = frequent_ss_items.item_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2000
    AND d_moy = 2
  GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c_last_name,
         c_first_name,
         SUM(ws_quantity * ws_list_price) AS sales
  FROM web_sales
  JOIN customer ON ws_bill_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  JOIN best_ss_customer ON ws_bill_customer_sk = best_ss_customer.c_customer_sk
  JOIN frequent_ss_items ON ws_item_sk = frequent_ss_items.item_sk
  WHERE d_year = 2000
    AND d_moy = 2
  GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name
) sq3
ORDER BY c_last_name NULLS FIRST,
         c_first_name NULLS FIRST,
         sales NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

  FROM (
    SELECT SUM(ss_quantity * ss_sales_price) AS total_sales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (2000, 2001, 2002, 2003)

strategy: Subquery Decorrelation and Predicate Pushdown: Filter date_dim and customer_address inside the CTEs to reduce the size of the aggregated intermediate results before the self-joins.
sql:
WITH ss AS (
    SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS store_sales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
),
ws AS (
    SELECT ca_county, d_qoy, d_year, sum(ws_ext_sales_price) AS web_sales
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy, d_year
)
SELECT ss1.ca_county,
       ss1.d_year,
       (ws2.web_sales * 1.0000) / ws1.web_sales AS web_q1_q2_increase,
       (ss2.store_sales * 1.0000) / ss1.store_sales AS store_q1_q2_increase,
       (ws3.web_sales * 1.0000) / ws2.web_sales AS web_q2_q3_increase,
       (ss3.store_sales * 1.0000) / ss2.store_sales AS store_q2_q3_increase
FROM ss ss1
JOIN ss ss2 ON ss1.ca_county = ss2.ca_county
JOIN ss ss3 ON ss2.ca_county = ss3.ca_county
JOIN ws ws1 ON ss1.ca_county = ws1.ca_county
JOIN ws ws2 ON ws1.ca_county = ws2.ca_county
JOIN ws ws3 ON ws2.ca_county = ws3.ca_county
WHERE ss1.d_qoy = 1 AND ss1.d_year = 2000
  AND ss2.d_qoy = 2 AND ss2.d_year = 2000
  AND ss3.d_qoy = 3 AND ss3.d_year = 2000
  AND ws1.d_qoy = 1 AND ws1.d_year = 2000
  AND ws2.d_qoy = 2 AND ws2.d_year = 2000
  AND ws3.d_qoy = 3 AND ws3.d_year = 2000
  AND (CASE WHEN ws1.web_sales > 0 THEN (ws2.web_sales * 1.0000) / ws1.web_sales ELSE NULL END) >
      (CASE WHEN ss1.store_sales > 0 THEN (ss2.store_sales * 1.0000) / ss1.store_sales ELSE NULL END)
  AND (CASE WHEN ws2.web_sales > 0 THEN (ws3.web_sales * 1.0000) / ws2.web_sales ELSE NULL END) >
      (CASE WHEN ss2.store_sales > 0 THEN (ss3.store_sales * 1.0000) / ss2.store_sales ELSE NULL END)
ORDER BY ss1.ca_county

strategy: Conditional Aggregation (Pivot): Instead of joining the aggregated CTEs three times (self-joins), aggregate once per channel using CASE statements to pivot Q1, Q2, Q3 into columns, then join the two pivoted results.
sql:
WITH ss_pivot AS (
    SELECT ca_county,
           sum(CASE WHEN d_qoy = 1 THEN ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS q1_sales,
           sum(CASE WHEN d_qoy = 2 THEN ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS q2_sales,
           sum(CASE WHEN d_qoy = 3 THEN ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS q3_sales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca_county
),
ws_pivot AS (
    SELECT ca_county,
           sum(CASE WHEN d_qoy = 1 THEN ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS q1_sales,
           sum(CASE WHEN d_qoy = 2 THEN ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS q2_sales,
           sum(CASE WHEN d_qoy = 3 THEN ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS q3_sales
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca_county
)
SELECT ss.ca_county,
       2000 AS d_year,
       (ws.q2_sales * 1.0000) / ws.q1_sales AS web_q1_q2_increase,
       (ss.q2_sales * 1.0000) / ss.q1_sales AS store_q1_q2_increase,
       (ws.q3_sales * 1.0000) / ws.q2_sales AS web_q2_q3_increase,
       (ss.q3_sales * 1.0000) / ss.q2_sales AS store_q2_q3_increase
FROM ss_pivot ss
JOIN ws_pivot ws ON ss.ca_county = ws.ca_county
WHERE (CASE WHEN ws.q1_sales > 0 THEN (ws.q2_sales * 1.0000) / ws.q1_sales ELSE NULL END) >
      (CASE WHEN ss.q1_sales > 0 THEN (ss.q2_sales * 1.0000) / ss.q1_sales ELSE NULL END)
  AND (CASE WHEN ws.q2_sales > 0 THEN (ws.q3_sales * 1.0000) / ws.q2_sales ELSE NULL END) >
      (CASE WHEN ss.q2_sales > 0 THEN (ss.q3_sales * 1.0000) / ss.q2_sales ELSE NULL END)
ORDER BY ss.ca_county

strategy: Lateral Join / Window Function Elimination: Use window functions to calculate ratios directly from the aggregated data without explicit self-joins on the CTEs, relying on LEAD/LAG or just filtering by Qoy after aggregation.
sql:
WITH combined AS (
    SELECT 'SS' AS channel, ca_county, d_qoy, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON ss_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'WS' AS channel, ca_county, d_qoy, sum(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address ON ws_bill_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2000 AND d_qoy IN (1, 2, 3)
    GROUP BY ca_county, d_qoy
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT ca_county,
           max(CASE WHEN channel = 'SS' AND d_qoy = 1 THEN sales END) AS ss1,
           max(CASE WHEN channel = 'SS' AND d_qoy = 2 THEN sales END) AS ss2,
           max(CASE WHEN channel = 'SS' AND d_qoy = 3 THEN sales END) AS ss3,
           max(CASE WHEN channel = 'WS' AND d_qoy = 1 THEN sales END) AS ws1,
           max(CASE WHEN channel = 'WS' AND d_qoy = 2 THEN sales END) AS ws2,
           max(CASE WHEN channel = 'WS' AND d_qoy = 3 THEN sales END) AS ws3
    FROM combined
    GROUP BY ca_county
)
SELECT ca_county,
       2000 AS d_year,
       (ws2 * 1.0000) / ws1 AS web_q1_q2_increase,
       (ss2 * 1.0000) / ss1 AS store_q1_q2_increase,
       (ws3 * 1.0000) / ws2 AS web_q2_q3_increase,
       (ss3 * 1.0000) / ss2 AS store_q2_q3_increase
FROM pivoted
WHERE (CASE WHEN ws1 > 0 THEN (ws2 * 1.0000) / ws1 ELSE NULL END) >
      (CASE WHEN ss1 > 0 THEN (ss2 * 1.0000) / ss1 ELSE NULL END)
  AND (CASE WHEN ws2 > 0 THEN (ws3 * 1.0000) / ws2 ELSE NULL END) >
      (CASE WHEN ss2 > 0 THEN (ss3 * 1.0000) / ss2 ELSE NULL END)
ORDER BY ca_county

sql:
WITH store_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ss_customer_sk
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  WHERE dd.d_year = 2002 AND dd.d_qoy < 4
),
web_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ws_bill_customer_sk
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN date_dim dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  WHERE dd.d_year = 2002 AND dd.d_qoy < 4
),
catalog_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cs_ship_customer_sk
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN date_dim dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
  WHERE dd.d_year = 2002 AND dd.d_qoy < 4
),
qualified_customers AS (
  SELECT sc.ss_customer_sk AS c_customer_sk
  FROM store_customers sc
  WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM web_customers wc WHERE wc.ws_bill_customer_sk = sc.ss_customer_sk)
     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM catalog_customers cc WHERE cc.cs_ship_customer_sk = sc.ss_customer_sk)
)
SELECT ca_state,
       cd_gender,
       cd_marital_status,
       cd_dep_count,
       count(*) cnt1,
       min(cd_dep_count) min1,
       max(cd_dep_count) max1,
       avg(cd_dep_count) avg1,
       cd_dep_employed_count,
       count(*) cnt2,
       min(cd_dep_employed_count) min2,
       max(cd_dep_employed_count) max2,
       avg(cd_dep_employed_count) avg2,
       cd_dep_college_count,
       count(*) cnt3,
       min(cd_dep_college_count),
       max(cd_dep_college_count),
       avg(cd_dep_college_count)
FROM customer c
JOIN customer_address ca ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics cd ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
JOIN qualified_customers qc ON c.c_customer_sk = qc.c_customer_sk
GROUP BY ca_state,
         cd_gender,
         cd_marital_status,
         cd_dep_count,
         cd_dep_employed_count,
         cd_dep_college_count
ORDER BY ca_state NULLS FIRST,
         cd_gender NULLS FIRST,
         cd_marital_status NULLS FIRST,
         cd_dep_count NULLS FIRST,
         cd_dep_employed_count NULLS FIRST,
         cd_dep_college_count NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

WITH inv_filtered AS (
    SELECT w_warehouse_name,
           w_warehouse_sk,
           i_item_sk,
           d_moy,
           CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE stdev/mean END AS cov,
           mean
    FROM (
        SELECT w_warehouse_name,
               w_warehouse_sk,
               i_item_sk,
               d_moy,
               stddev_samp(inv_quantity_on_hand)*1.000 stdev,
               avg(inv_quantity_on_hand) mean
        FROM inventory
        JOIN item ON inv_item_sk = i_item_sk
        JOIN warehouse ON inv_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
        JOIN date_dim ON inv_date_sk = d_date_sk
        WHERE d_year = 2001
          AND d_moy IN (1, 2)
        GROUP BY w_warehouse_name, w_warehouse_sk, i_item_sk, d_moy
    ) foo
    WHERE CASE mean WHEN 0 THEN 0 ELSE stdev/mean END > 1
)
SELECT inv1.w_warehouse_sk wsk1,

       inv2.w_warehouse_sk,
       inv2.i_item_sk,
       inv2.d_moy,
       inv2.mean,
       inv2.cov
FROM inv_filtered inv1
JOIN inv_filtered inv2
  ON inv1.i_item_sk = inv2.i_item_sk
 AND inv1.w_warehouse_sk = inv2.w_warehouse_sk

WITH web_data AS (

WITH v1 AS (
  SELECT i_category,
         i_brand,
         cc_name,
         d_year,
         d_moy,
         sum(cs_sales_price) AS sum_sales,
         avg(sum(cs_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category, i_brand, cc_name, d_year) AS avg_monthly_sales,
         rank() OVER (PARTITION BY i_category, i_brand, cc_name ORDER BY d_year, d_moy) AS rn
  FROM item,
       catalog_sales,
       date_dim,
       call_center
  WHERE cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
    AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    AND cc_call_center_sk = cs_call_center_sk
    AND (d_year = 1999
         OR (d_year = 1998 AND d_moy = 12)
         OR (d_year = 2000 AND d_moy = 1))
  GROUP BY i_category,
           i_brand,
           cc_name,
           d_year,
           d_moy
),
v2 AS (
  SELECT i_category,
         i_brand,
         cc_name,
         d_year,
         d_moy,
         avg_monthly_sales,
         sum_sales,
         lag(sum_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category, i_brand, cc_name ORDER BY d_year, d_moy) AS psum,
         lead(sum_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY i_category, i_brand, cc_name ORDER BY d_year, d_moy) AS nsum
  FROM v1
)
SELECT *
FROM v2
WHERE d_year = 1999
  AND avg_monthly_sales > 0
  AND CASE
        WHEN avg_monthly_sales > 0 THEN abs(sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales) / avg_monthly_sales
        ELSE NULL
      END > 0.1
ORDER BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales NULLS FIRST, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9
LIMIT 100

WITH v1 AS (

         i.i_brand,
         cc.cc_name,

         rank() OVER (PARTITION BY i.i_category, i.i_brand, cc.cc_name ORDER BY d.d_year, d.d_moy) AS rn
  FROM item i
  JOIN catalog_sales cs ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN call_center cc ON cc.cc_call_center_sk = cs.cs_call_center_sk
  WHERE (d.d_year = 1999
         OR (d.d_year = 1998 AND d.d_moy = 12)
         OR (d.d_year = 2000 AND d.d_moy = 1))
  GROUP BY i.i_category,
           i.i_brand,
           cc.cc_name,
           d.d_year,
           d.d_moy
),
v2 AS (
  SELECT v1.i_category,
         v1.i_brand,
         v1.cc_name,
         v1.d_year,
         v1.d_moy,
         v1.avg_monthly_sales,
         v1.sum_sales,
         v1_lag.sum_sales AS psum,
         v1_lead.sum_sales AS nsum
  FROM v1
  JOIN v1 v1_lag ON v1.i_category = v1_lag.i_category
                AND v1.i_brand = v1_lag.i_brand
                AND v1.cc_name = v1_lag.cc_name
                AND v1.rn = v1_lag.rn + 1
  JOIN v1 v1_lead ON v1.i_category = v1_lead.i_category
                 AND v1.i_brand = v1_lead.i_brand
                 AND v1.cc_name = v1_lead.cc_name
                 AND v1.rn = v1_lead.rn - 1
)

        ELSE NULL

ORDER BY sum_sales - avg_monthly_sales NULLS FIRST, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9

strategy: Union All approach: Aggregate sales channels into a single stream, pivot, then filter
sql:
WITH date_range AS (
  SELECT d_date_sk
  FROM date_dim
  WHERE d_week_seq = (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_date = '2000-01-03')
),
all_sales AS (
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id, 'SS' AS channel, ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS rev
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN item i ON ss.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id, 'CS' AS channel, cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS rev
  FROM catalog_sales cs
  JOIN item i ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
  UNION ALL
  SELECT i.i_item_id AS item_id, 'WS' AS channel, ws.ws_ext_sales_price AS rev
  FROM web_sales ws
  JOIN item i ON ws.ws_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN date_range dr ON d.d_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
),
pivoted AS (
  SELECT item_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'SS' THEN rev ELSE 0 END) AS ss_item_rev,
         SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'CS' THEN rev ELSE 0 END) AS cs_item_rev,
         SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'WS' THEN rev ELSE 0 END) AS ws_item_rev
  FROM all_sales
  GROUP BY item_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'SS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'CS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'WS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
)
SELECT item_id,
       ss_item_rev,
       ss_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ss_dev,
       cs_item_rev,
       cs_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS cs_dev,
       ws_item_rev,
       ws_item_rev / ((ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3) * 100 AS ws_dev,
       (ss_item_rev + cs_item_rev + ws_item_rev) / 3 AS average
FROM pivoted
WHERE ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev
  AND ss_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev
  AND cs_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ws_item_rev AND 1.1 * ws_item_rev
  AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * ss_item_rev AND 1.1 * ss_item_rev
  AND ws_item_rev BETWEEN 0.9 * cs_item_rev AND 1.1 * cs_item_rev
ORDER BY item_id NULLS FIRST, ss_item_rev NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

strategy: CTE Materialization & Predicate Pushdown: Filter date_dim early in the CTE to reduce the size of the aggregated result set before joining.
sql:
WITH wss_filtered AS (
  SELECT d_week_seq,
         ss_store_sk,
         sum(CASE WHEN d_day_name='Sunday' THEN ss_sales_price END) sun_sales,
         sum(CASE WHEN d_day_name='Monday' THEN ss_sales_price END) mon_sales,
         sum(CASE WHEN d_day_name='Tuesday' THEN ss_sales_price END) tue_sales,
         sum(CASE WHEN d_day_name='Wednesday' THEN ss_sales_price END) wed_sales,
         sum(CASE WHEN d_day_name='Thursday' THEN ss_sales_price END) thu_sales,
         sum(CASE WHEN d_day_name='Friday' THEN ss_sales_price END) fri_sales,
         sum(CASE WHEN d_day_name='Saturday' THEN ss_sales_price END) sat_sales
  FROM store_sales
  JOIN date_dim ON d_date_sk = ss_sold_date_sk
  WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1235
  GROUP BY d_week_seq, ss_store_sk
)
SELECT s1.s_store_name AS s_store_name1,
       s1.s_store_id AS s_store_id1,
       w1.d_week_seq AS d_week_seq1,
       w1.sun_sales / w2.sun_sales AS sun_sales_ratio,
       w1.mon_sales / w2.mon_sales AS mon_sales_ratio,
       w1.tue_sales / w2.tue_sales AS tue_sales_ratio,
       w1.wed_sales / w2.wed_sales AS wed_sales_ratio,
       w1.thu_sales / w2.thu_sales AS thu_sales_ratio,
       w1.fri_sales / w2.fri_sales AS fri_sales_ratio,
       w1.sat_sales / w2.sat_sales AS sat_sales_ratio
FROM wss_filtered w1
JOIN store s1 ON w1.ss_store_sk = s1.s_store_sk
JOIN wss_filtered w2 ON w1.ss_store_sk = w2.ss_store_sk AND w1.d_week_seq = w2.d_week_seq - 52
JOIN store s2 ON w2.ss_store_sk = s2.s_store_sk
WHERE w1.d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1223)
  AND w2.d_week_seq IN (SELECT d_week_seq FROM date_dim WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1224 AND 1235)
ORDER BY s_store_name1 NULLS FIRST, s_store_id1 NULLS FIRST, d_week_seq1 NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

WITH cs_ui AS (
    SELECT cs_item_sk,
           sum(cs_ext_list_price) AS sale,
           sum(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit) AS refund
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
    GROUP BY cs_item_sk
    HAVING sum(cs_ext_list_price) > 2 * sum(cr_refunded_cash + cr_reversed_charge + cr_store_credit)
),
cross_sales AS (
    SELECT i_product_name product_name,
           i_item_sk item_sk,
           s_store_name store_name,
           s_zip store_zip,
           ad1.ca_street_number b_street_number,
           ad1.ca_street_name b_street_name,
           ad1.ca_city b_city,
           ad1.ca_zip b_zip,
           ad2.ca_street_number c_street_number,
           ad2.ca_street_name c_street_name,
           ad2.ca_city c_city,
           ad2.ca_zip c_zip,
           d1.d_year AS syear,
           d2.d_year AS fsyear,
           d3.d_year s2year,
           count(*) cnt,
           sum(ss_wholesale_cost) s1,
           sum(ss_list_price) s2,
           sum(ss_coupon_amt) s3
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
    JOIN cs_ui ON ss_item_sk = cs_ui.cs_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk
    JOIN customer ON ss_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim d2 ON c_first_sales_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk
    JOIN date_dim d3 ON c_first_shipto_date_sk = d3.d_date_sk
    JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd1 ON ss_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_demographics cd2 ON c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd1 ON ss_hdemo_sk = hd1.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN household_demographics hd2 ON c_current_hdemo_sk = hd2.hd_demo_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad1 ON ss_addr_sk = ad1.ca_address_sk
    JOIN customer_address ad2 ON c_current_addr_sk = ad2.ca_address_sk
    JOIN income_band ib1 ON hd1.hd_income_band_sk = ib1.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN income_band ib2 ON hd2.hd_income_band_sk = ib2.ib_income_band_sk
    JOIN item ON ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
    JOIN promotion ON ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
    WHERE cd1.cd_marital_status <> cd2.cd_marital_status
      AND i_color IN ('purple', 'burlywood', 'indian', 'spring', 'floral', 'medium')
      AND i_current_price BETWEEN 65 AND 74
    GROUP BY i_product_name,
             i_item_sk,
             s_store_name,
             s_zip,
             ad1.ca_street_number,
             ad1.ca_street_name,
             ad1.ca_city,
             ad1.ca_zip,
             ad2.ca_street_number,
             ad2.ca_street_name,
             ad2.ca_city,
             ad2.ca_zip,
             d1.d_year,
             d2.d_year,
             d3.d_year
)

strategy: CTE Materialization and Predicate Pushdown: Pre-filter CTEs by year and sale type to reduce intermediate result sizes before the self-joins.
sql:
WITH year_total AS (
  SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year, sum(ss_net_paid) AS year_total, 's' AS sale_type
  FROM customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year, sum(ws_net_paid) AS year_total, 'w' AS sale_type
  FROM customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year
)
SELECT t_s_secyear.customer_id, t_s_secyear.customer_first_name, t_s_secyear.customer_last_name
FROM year_total t_s_firstyear
JOIN year_total t_s_secyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_s_secyear.customer_id
JOIN year_total t_w_firstyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_firstyear.customer_id
JOIN year_total t_w_secyear ON t_s_firstyear.customer_id = t_w_secyear.customer_id
WHERE t_s_firstyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_s_firstyear.year_ = 2001 AND t_s_firstyear.year_total > 0
  AND t_s_secyear.sale_type = 's' AND t_s_secyear.year_ = 2002
  AND t_w_firstyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_w_firstyear.year_ = 2001 AND t_w_firstyear.year_total > 0
  AND t_w_secyear.sale_type = 'w' AND t_w_secyear.year_ = 2002
  AND (t_w_secyear.year_total / t_w_firstyear.year_total) > (t_s_secyear.year_total / t_s_firstyear.year_total)
ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST

strategy: Conditional Aggregation (Pivot): Replace 4-way self-join on CTE with a single scan using CASE WHEN inside SUM to pivot years and channels into columns.
sql:
WITH customer_year_totals AS (
  SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 's' AND year_ = 2001 THEN year_total ELSE 0 END) AS s_2001,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 's' AND year_ = 2002 THEN year_total ELSE 0 END) AS s_2002,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 'w' AND year_ = 2001 THEN year_total ELSE 0 END) AS w_2001,
    SUM(CASE WHEN sale_type = 'w' AND year_ = 2002 THEN year_total ELSE 0 END) AS w_2002
  FROM (
    SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year AS year_, sum(ss_net_paid) AS year_total, 's' AS sale_type
    FROM customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year AS year_, sum(ws_net_paid) AS year_total, 'w' AS sale_type
    FROM customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
    GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year
  ) sub
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name
)
SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name
FROM customer_year_totals
WHERE s_2001 > 0 AND w_2001 > 0
  AND (w_2002 / w_2001) > (s_2002 / s_2001)
ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

strategy: Decorrelated Joins with Direct Table Access: Avoid CTE materialization by joining base tables directly and filtering early on date_dim.
sql:
SELECT c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
FROM customer c
JOIN store_sales ss1 ON c.c_customer_sk = ss1.ss_customer_sk
JOIN date_dim d1 ON ss1.ss_sold_date_sk = d1.d_date_sk AND d1.d_year = 2001
JOIN store_sales ss2 ON c.c_customer_sk = ss2.ss_customer_sk
JOIN date_dim d2 ON ss2.ss_sold_date_sk = d2.d_date_sk AND d2.d_year = 2002
JOIN web_sales ws1 ON c.c_customer_sk = ws1.ws_bill_customer_sk
JOIN date_dim dw1 ON ws1.ws_sold_date_sk = dw1.d_date_sk AND dw1.d_year = 2001
JOIN web_sales ws2 ON c.c_customer_sk = ws2.ws_bill_customer_sk
JOIN date_dim dw2 ON ws2.ws_sold_date_sk = dw2.d_date_sk AND dw2.d_year = 2002
GROUP BY c.c_customer_id, c.c_first_name, c.c_last_name
HAVING sum(ss1.ss_net_paid) > 0
   AND sum(ws1.ws_net_paid) > 0
   AND (sum(ws2.ws_net_paid) / sum(ws1.ws_net_paid)) > (sum(ss2.ss_net_paid) / sum(ss1.ss_net_paid))
ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

strategy: Window Functions for Year Over Year: Use window functions to calculate totals per year within a single scan, then filter using window results.
sql:
WITH combined_sales AS (
  SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year, 's' AS type, ss_net_paid AS amt
  FROM customer JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year, 'w' AS type, ws_net_paid AS amt
  FROM customer JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
  JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
  WHERE d_year IN (2001, 2002)
),
year_totals AS (
  SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name, d_year, type,
    SUM(amt) OVER (PARTITION BY c_customer_id, type, d_year) AS year_total
  FROM combined_sales
)
SELECT DISTINCT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name
FROM (
  SELECT c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name,
    MAX(CASE WHEN type='s' AND d_year=2001 THEN year_total END) AS s1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN type='s' AND d_year=2002 THEN year_total END) AS s2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN type='w' AND d_year=2001 THEN year_total END) AS w1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN type='w' AND d_year=2002 THEN year_total END) AS w2
  FROM year_totals
  GROUP BY c_customer_id, c_first_name, c_last_name
) t
WHERE s1 > 0 AND w1 > 0 AND (w2/w1) > (s2/s1)
ORDER BY 1 NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100

SELECT c_customer_id AS customer_id,

               SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2002 THEN ss_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS s_2002,
               SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2001 THEN ws_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS w_2001,
               SUM(CASE WHEN d_year = 2002 THEN ws_net_paid ELSE 0 END) AS w_2002
        FROM customer c2

        LEFT JOIN date_dim ss_d ON ss_sold_date_sk = ss_d.d_date_sk
        LEFT JOIN web_sales ON c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
        LEFT JOIN date_dim ws_d ON ws_sold_date_sk = ws_d.d_date_sk
        WHERE c2.c_customer_id = customer.c_customer_id
        GROUP BY c_customer_id

WITH base_data AS (
  SELECT c_customer_id,
         c_first_name,
         c_last_name,
         d_year,
         's' AS sale_type,
         ss_net_paid AS amount
  FROM customer
  JOIN store_sales ON c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk

aggregated AS (
  SELECT c_customer_id,

strategy: Filter Pushdown and Join Elimination: Remove redundant joins to dimension tables (store, web_page) in CTEs where the join key is the grouping key and no other columns from those tables are used. This reduces join overhead.
sql:
WITH ss AS
  (SELECT ss_store_sk AS s_store_sk,
          sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
          sum(ss_net_profit) AS profit
   FROM store_sales
   WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
   GROUP BY ss_store_sk) ,
     sr AS
  (SELECT sr_store_sk AS s_store_sk,
          sum(sr_return_amt) AS returns_,
          sum(sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
   FROM store_returns
   WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
   GROUP BY sr_store_sk),
     cs AS
  (SELECT cs_call_center_sk,
          sum(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
          sum(cs_net_profit) AS profit
   FROM catalog_sales
   WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
   GROUP BY cs_call_center_sk),
     cr AS
  (SELECT cr_call_center_sk,
          sum(cr_return_amount) AS returns_,
          sum(cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
   FROM catalog_returns
   WHERE cr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
   GROUP BY cr_call_center_sk ),
     ws AS
  (SELECT ws_web_page_sk AS wp_web_page_sk,
          sum(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
          sum(ws_net_profit) AS profit
   FROM web_sales
   WHERE ws_sold_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
   GROUP BY ws_web_page_sk),
     wr AS
  (SELECT wr_web_page_sk AS wp_web_page_sk,
          sum(wr_return_amt) AS returns_,
          sum(wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
   FROM web_returns
   WHERE wr_returned_date_sk IN (SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
   GROUP BY wr_web_page_sk)
SELECT channel ,
       id ,
       sum(sales) AS sales ,
       sum(returns_) AS returns_ ,
       sum(profit) AS profit
FROM
  (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel ,
          ss.s_store_sk AS id ,
          sales ,
          coalesce(returns_, 0) AS returns_ ,
          (profit - coalesce(profit_loss,0)) AS profit
   FROM ss
   LEFT JOIN sr ON ss.s_store_sk = sr.s_store_sk
   UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel ,
                    cs_call_center_sk AS id ,
                    sales ,
                    returns_ ,
                    (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
   FROM cs ,
        cr
   UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel ,
                    ws.wp_web_page_sk AS id ,
                    sales ,
                    coalesce(returns_, 0) returns_ ,
                    (profit - coalesce(profit_loss,0)) AS profit
   FROM ws
   LEFT JOIN wr ON ws.wp_web_page_sk = wr.wp_web_page_sk ) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel,
                 id)
ORDER BY channel NULLS FIRST,
         id NULLS FIRST,
         returns_ DESC
LIMIT 100

strategy: Merge sales and returns CTEs into single aggregations using CASE WHEN to reduce scan operations and UNION ALL parts.
sql:
WITH store_data AS
  (SELECT s_store_sk,
          sum(CASE WHEN ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN ss_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS sales,
          sum(CASE WHEN ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN ss_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit,
          sum(CASE WHEN sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN sr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS returns_,
          sum(CASE WHEN sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN sr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS profit_loss
   FROM store_sales
   JOIN date_dim ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
   JOIN store ON ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
   LEFT JOIN store_returns ON ss_item_sk = sr_item_sk AND ss_ticket_number = sr_ticket_number
   LEFT JOIN date_dim AS dr ON sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
   WHERE (ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
      OR (sr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk AND dr.d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
   GROUP BY s_store_sk),
     catalog_data AS
  (SELECT coalesce(cs_call_center_sk, cr_call_center_sk) AS id,
          sum(CASE WHEN cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN cs_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS sales,
          sum(CASE WHEN cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN cs_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit,
          sum(CASE WHEN cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN cr_return_amount ELSE 0 END) AS returns_,
          sum(CASE WHEN cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN cr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS profit_loss
   FROM catalog_sales
   JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
   FULL OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number
   FULL OUTER JOIN date_dim AS dr ON cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
   WHERE (cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
      OR (cr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk AND dr.d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
   GROUP BY coalesce(cs_call_center_sk, cr_call_center_sk)),
     web_data AS
  (SELECT wp_web_page_sk,
          sum(CASE WHEN ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN ws_ext_sales_price ELSE 0 END) AS sales,
          sum(CASE WHEN ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN ws_net_profit ELSE 0 END) AS profit,
          sum(CASE WHEN wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN wr_return_amt ELSE 0 END) AS returns_,
          sum(CASE WHEN wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk THEN wr_net_loss ELSE 0 END) AS profit_loss
   FROM web_sales
   JOIN date_dim ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
   JOIN web_page ON ws_web_page_sk = wp_web_page_sk
   LEFT JOIN web_returns ON ws_item_sk = wr_item_sk AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number
   LEFT JOIN date_dim AS dr ON wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
   WHERE (ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
      OR (wr_returned_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk AND dr.d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date))
   GROUP BY wp_web_page_sk)
SELECT channel ,
       id ,
       sum(sales) AS sales ,
       sum(returns_) AS returns_ ,
       sum(profit) AS profit
FROM
  (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel ,
          s_store_sk AS id ,
          sales ,
          returns_ ,
          (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
   FROM store_data
   UNION ALL SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel ,
                    id ,
                    sales ,
                    returns_ ,
                    (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
   FROM catalog_data
   UNION ALL SELECT 'web channel' AS channel ,
                    wp_web_page_sk AS id ,
                    sales ,
                    returns_ ,
                    (profit - profit_loss) AS profit
   FROM web_data ) x
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel,
                 id)
ORDER BY channel NULLS FIRST,
         id NULLS FIRST,
         returns_ DESC
LIMIT 100

strategy: Replace the UNION ALL subquery with a set of LEFT JOINs on a master list of IDs per channel, avoiding the materialization of the intermediate UNION ALL result and allowing the optimizer to push down predicates and choose better join orders for the aggregation.
sql:
WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim WHERE d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date)
),
ss AS (
    SELECT ss_store_sk AS id, sum(ss_ext_sales_price) AS sales, sum(ss_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM store_sales JOIN date_range ON ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ss_store_sk
),
sr AS (
    SELECT sr_store_sk AS id, sum(sr_return_amt) AS returns_, sum(sr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM store_returns JOIN date_range ON sr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY sr_store_sk
),
cs AS (
    SELECT cs_call_center_sk AS id, sum(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales, sum(cs_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM catalog_sales JOIN date_range ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cs_call_center_sk
),
cr AS (
    SELECT cr_call_center_sk AS id, sum(cr_return_amount) AS returns_, sum(cr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM catalog_returns JOIN date_range ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY cr_call_center_sk
),
ws AS (
    SELECT ws_web_page_sk AS id, sum(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales, sum(ws_net_profit) AS profit
    FROM web_sales JOIN date_range ON ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY ws_web_page_sk
),
wr AS (
    SELECT wr_web_page_sk AS id, sum(wr_return_amt) AS returns_, sum(wr_net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM web_returns JOIN date_range ON wr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    GROUP BY wr_web_page_sk
),
store_channel AS (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel, ss.id, ss.sales, coalesce(sr.returns_, 0) AS returns_, (ss.profit - coalesce(sr.profit_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM ss LEFT JOIN sr ON ss.id = sr.id
),
catalog_channel AS (
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel, cs.id, cs.sales, coalesce(cr.returns_, 0) AS returns_, (cs.profit - coalesce(cr.profit_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM cs LEFT JOIN cr ON cs.id = cr.id
),
web_channel AS (
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel, ws.id, ws.sales, coalesce(wr.returns_, 0) AS returns_, (ws.profit - coalesce(wr.profit_loss, 0)) AS profit
    FROM ws LEFT JOIN wr ON ws.id = wr.id
),
all_channels AS (
    SELECT * FROM store_channel
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM catalog_channel
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM web_channel
)
SELECT channel ,
       id ,
       sum(sales) AS sales ,
       sum(returns_) AS returns_ ,
       sum(profit) AS profit
FROM all_channels
GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel,
                 id)
ORDER BY channel NULLS FIRST,
         id NULLS FIRST,
         returns_ DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH ssr AS

          sum(ss_net_profit - coalesce(sr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit

                                                                               store,
                                                                               item,
                                                                               promotion
   WHERE ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk

     AND ss_store_sk = s_store_sk
     AND ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
     AND i_current_price > 50

   GROUP BY s_store_id) ,
     csr AS
  (SELECT cp_catalog_page_id AS catalog_page_id,
          sum(cs_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
          sum(coalesce(cr_return_amount, 0)) AS returns_,
          sum(cs_net_profit - coalesce(cr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
   FROM catalog_sales
   LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk
                                       AND cs_order_number = cr_order_number), date_dim,

                                                                               item,
                                                                               promotion
   WHERE cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
     AND d_date BETWEEN cast('2000-08-23' AS date) AND cast('2000-09-22' AS date)
     AND cs_catalog_page_sk = cp_catalog_page_sk
     AND cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
     AND i_current_price > 50
     AND cs_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
     AND p_channel_tv = 'N'
   GROUP BY cp_catalog_page_id) ,
     wsr AS
  (SELECT web_site_id,
          sum(ws_ext_sales_price) AS sales,
          sum(coalesce(wr_return_amt, 0)) AS returns_,
          sum(ws_net_profit - coalesce(wr_net_loss, 0)) AS profit
   FROM web_sales

                                   AND ws_order_number = wr_order_number), date_dim,

     AND i_current_price > 50
     AND ws_promo_sk = p_promo_sk
     AND p_channel_tv = 'N'
   GROUP BY web_site_id)
SELECT channel ,
       id ,
       sum(sales) AS sales ,
       sum(returns_) AS returns_ ,
       sum(profit) AS profit
FROM
  (SELECT 'store channel' AS channel ,
          concat('store', store_id) AS id ,

          profit
   FROM ssr

                    sales ,
                    returns_ ,
                    profit

GROUP BY ROLLUP (channel,

ORDER BY channel NULLS FIRST,

WITH target_weeks AS (

),

  JOIN item i ON sr.sr_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
  JOIN date_dim d ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  JOIN target_weeks tw ON d.d_week_seq = tw.d_week_seq

         SUM(cr.cr_return_quantity) AS cr_item_qty

),

SELECT sr.item_id,
       sr.sr_item_qty,

       cr.cr_item_qty,

FROM sr_items sr
JOIN cr_items cr ON sr.item_id = cr.item_id
JOIN wr_items wr ON sr.item_id = wr.item_id
ORDER BY sr.item_id NULLS FIRST,

strategy: Subquery flattening: Inline the derived table sq1 directly into the FROM clause to allow the optimizer to push predicates and join orders more effectively without materialization overhead.
sql:
SELECT SUBSTRING(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20) AS w_substr,
       sm_type,
       LOWER(cc_name) AS cc_name_lower,
       SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 30) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "30 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 30) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 60) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "31-60 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 60) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "61-90 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 90) AND (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk <= 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "91-120 days",
       SUM(CASE WHEN (cs_ship_date_sk - cs_sold_date_sk > 120) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ">120 days"
FROM catalog_sales
JOIN warehouse ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
JOIN ship_mode ON cs_ship_mode_sk = sm_ship_mode_sk
JOIN call_center ON cs_call_center_sk = cc_call_center_sk
JOIN date_dim ON cs_ship_date_sk = d_date_sk
WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1200 AND 1200 + 11
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(w_warehouse_name, 1, 20), sm_type, cc_name
ORDER BY w_substr NULLS FIRST, sm_type NULLS FIRST, cc_name_lower NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 100
